Kareena Kapoor Khan Attends 'Daayra' Trailer Launch in Vintage Outfit

Actress Kareena Kapoor Khan attended the trailer launch event for her upcoming film 'Daayra' in Mumbai. She wore a 23-year-old vintage Versace pantsuit for the occasion. During the event, Kapoor Khan spoke about how motherhood has influenced her acting, mentioning the emotional impact of her role in 'Daayra'. She also commented on the film's potential clash with her brother-in-law Kunal Kemmu's project, stating it would be released within their family. Alia Bhatt was also present to support Kapoor Khan and the film's director, Meghna Gulzar.
